description: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.

en.question: What is the grey-haired man doing?

de.answer: Er vergräbt sein Gesicht in den Händen.
de.question: Was macht der grauhaarige Mann?

es.answer: Está escondiendo la cara entre las manos.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre canoso?

fr.answer: Il enfouit son visage dans ses mains.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme aux cheveux gris ?
